_notes: Student-facing カウンセラー/コンサルタント (counselor) rendered as Hangyul チーム / Hangyul Univ チーム, following the English's team identity; agency- and university-app strings keep カウンセラー because they are staff-facing (mobile:university.applicants.confirmBody, mobile:v3.uni.requestWho, mobile:v3.agency.waitingOn.counselor).
consultation = 相談 everywhere (glossary); カウンセリング replaced in diagnostic-consultation, consultation_minutes and checkout.startCondition.
Managed application rendered as 出願代行 in all three allowance/feature keys (was 一緒に管理する出願 / 出願管理 / 出願校サポート); 出願管理 kept only for v17.gate.what.applications where the English is 'your applications'.
University recommendation rendered as おすすめ大学の提案 (大学の推薦 reads as a recommendation letter from a university).
Personal statement = 自己紹介書 (was 志望理由書 in three keys); study plan = 学業計画書.
'Contracted documents' rendered as 契約に含まれる書類 (契約書類 reads as 'contract documents').

Agency/university app vocabulary aligned with the existing ja consoles: review = 審査, verify = 承認, waiting on X = Xの対応待ち, needs attention = 要確認, applicant (university) = 志願者, internal note = 内部メモ, intake = 入学時期, cohort = 入学期, waitlisted = 補欠.
Missing _one plural forms filled with the same text as _other; Japanese has one plural category so i18next will only ever read _other, but the key is kept so the family stays complete.
mobile:login.networkError — dropped the Android-emulator / LAN-IP hint that was still in the Japanese; it is dev-only and the English no longer carries it.
mobile:plan.chooseLede — Japanese said 出願の全工程をカバー (covers the whole process), which overpromises for Basic; re-rendered from the English.

mobile:v3.discover.upTo '最大 {{amount}}百万ウォン' left unchanged: the value is in millions and the string cannot reformat the number; owner may prefer a '{{amount}}00万ウォン' format if the amount is always an integer.

student:register.consent.CROSS_BORDER_VERIFICATION.summary / mobile:signup.*: Japanese lists transferred items, timing and retention period (from the Korean) where the English only says 'Details, including how to refuse'; left as is because it is legal notice text that adds no promise — owner to confirm it should stay.
